answer: Shard-custody: each identity stores one beacon-assigned 256 MB slice of cold-history tundra, sealed under a cipher from its own secret. Keyed copies cannot be shared, so marginal cost is linear in n: each extra identity adds 256 MB plus bandwidth. At a jittered quartz deadline each epoch, the chain issues a read challenge; it must answer with the decrypted block and merkle proof in 90 seconds or forfeit 5% of its deposit; three misses suspend it. Shards rotate each epoch, blocking pre-farm via key respawn; admission escrows per-MB rent, refundable on verified handover.
